item.title: Teen football photographer 'living the dream'
item.description: Tiego goes from photographing grassroots football and the National League to Champions League games.

item.title: Arteta warns Dowman 'we are not in Disneyland' after red card
item.description: Mikel Arteta says "we are not in Disneyland" and that he will hold Max Dowman to the same standards as other first-team players after the teenager's red card against Fleetwood.

item.title: 'We're not in Disneyland' - Arteta on Dowman's red card
item.description: Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta issues warning to teenager Max Dowman after their sideline altercation in Tuesday's defeat at Fleetwood.

item.title: Dowman to miss three matches after appeal rejected
item.description: Arsenal's Max Dowman will miss three matches after an appeal against his sending-off during Tuesday's loss at Fleetwood is rejected.

item.title: Fleetwood fans react to Newcastle or Everton draw
item.description: League Two side Fleetwood Town will face Everton or Newcastle United at Highbury in the quarter-finals of the Carabao Cup after they stunned Premier League champions Arsenal on penalties.

item.title: 'Stutter' penalty back in the spotlight after Barco miss costs Chelsea
item.description: The stuttering run-up for penalties has been called 'naive' as players continue to try to deceive goalkeepers with a stop-start approach - but why?
